questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
Can a corporation give unlimited money to a super PAC?
questions.why: Since Citizens United and SpeechNow.org (2010), corporations, unions and individuals can give super PACs unlimited sums.

questions.prompt: Groups helping Republicans have spent $6.1M in WA's 3rd District House race. Are Republicans playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Democrats hold this seat now, so money helping Republicans here is offense.

questions.prompt: In the final 20 days, a campaign gets a $2,000 check. What must it do?
questions.why: Contributions of $1,000 or more received in the last 20 days must be reported within 48 hours on Form 6.

questions.prompt: Groups helping Democrats have spent $1.1M in LA's 6th District House race. Are Democrats playing offense or defense?
questions.why: Democrats hold this seat now, so money helping Democrats here is defense.

questions.prompt: Which race has drawn more outside money so far in the general election?
In AZ's 6th District House race, outside money favors Republicans by $560K. Whose nominee has raised more?
questions.why: Outside money and candidate money point opposite ways here: the Democrat leads fundraising by $1.2M.

questions.prompt: How often do House and Senate campaigns file their regular reports in an election year?
questions.why: Candidate committees file quarterly, plus 12 days before and 30 days after each election. Monthly filing is only an option for PACs and parties.

questions.prompt: CLF (a super PAC) has spent $3.1M in TX's 34th District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Republican or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.

questions.prompt: Giffords PAC (a super PAC) has spent $860K in PA's 8th District House race. Which party is it helping?
questions.why: Its spending supports the Democrat or attacks their opponent. Every group's filings list who it backs or opposes.
